content.text: I have what I need. Article VII contains a full transition regime.

input.quote: (a) Cooperation on Termination. On its resignation or termination, the Servicer will cooperate with the Issuer, the Owner Trustee, the Indenture Trustee and the Successor Servicer in effecting (i) the termination of its rights and obligations under this Agreement and (ii) an orderly transition of such rights and obligations to the Successor Servicer.
input.rationale: A usable exit/transition regime exists and clears the fallback. Section 7.5 requires the outgoing Servicer to cooperate in an orderly transition (7.5(a)), to transfer all funds and to deliver the Receivable Files and the accounts and records it maintains to the Successor Servicer as soon as practicable after the effective date of resignation or termination (7.5(b)), and to bear all reasonable transition expenses of the Issuer, Owner Trustee, Indenture Trustee and Successor Servicer (7.5(c)) — i.e. transition assistance at the Servicer's cost rather than at its then-current rates, which is better than the preferred position for us. Section 7.3 requires Cellco to continue performing until a Successor Servicer accepts engagement (and to continue remittance obligations under 3.12(b) while any Receivable has a Principal Balance), so assistance runs well beyond 90 days/6 months. Section 3.10(f) separately requires the Custodian to deliver the Receivable Files to the Indenture Trustee or successor custodian on termination of its custodial appointment, again at the terminated custodian's expense. Walk-away territory (no data return, or immediate deletion) is not present. Minor sub-elements short of the model language, noted but not redlined: file/record delivery is "as soon as practicable" rather than a hard 30-day deadline; there is no deletion-and-certification mechanic (unsurprising here, since Cellco remains Marketing Agent/Administrator and needs Obligor data to bill the underlying accounts); and 7.5(b) carves out the Servicer's proprietary processes, models and servicing software and items restricted by confidentiality or privacy policies. We would raise the 30-day delivery outside date only as a low-priority comment.
